async function once() {
	for (let index = await loadStart(); index < 6; index++) {
		consume(index);
	}
	let index;
	for (index = await loadStart(); index < 6; index++) consume(index);
	for (await prepare(); index < 6; index++) consume(index);
	for (
		let rows = await loadRows(), cursor = 0;
		cursor < rows.length;
		cursor++
	) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		await save(rows[cursor]);
	}
	for (
		let left = await loadStart(), right = await loadEnd();
		left < right;
		left++
	) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		await save(left);
	}
}

async function repeated(groups) {
	// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
	for (let index = 0; await hasNext(); index++) consume(index);
	// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
	for (let index = 0; index < 6; await advance()) consume(index);
	for (let index = await loadStart(); index < 6; index++) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		await save(index);
	}
	for (const group of groups) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		for (let index = await loadStart(group); index < 6; index++) consume(index);
	}
	for (let outer = 0; outer < 4; outer++) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		for (let index = await loadStart(outer); index < 6; index++) consume(index);
	}
	// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
	for (let index = 0; await hasNext(); index++, tick()) consume(index);
	// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
	for (let index = 0; index < 6; index++, await advance()) consume(index);
}
